enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Quality Will Save +2: This item gives a +2 Quality bonus to your Will saves.
Profane Well Rounded +1: +1 Profane bonus to all abilities.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +7 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
